decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost spells to build a board presence and deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. It utilizes cheap instants and sorceries to trigger prowess abilities on creatures like Sprite Dragon, Monastery Swiftspear, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The cards in the deck allow for explosive turns, with cards like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart providing direct damage to the opponent and creatures. The companion card, Jegantha, the Wellspring, adds an extra card to the deck and provides additional mana acceleration. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient aggression.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells for free through cascade mechanics to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury, the deck aims to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower provides additional disruption to opponents' strategies, while Blood Moon can shut down certain types of decks, giving this deck a versatile and punishing playstyle.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain constant pressure on the opponent by efficiently using cheap spells and creatures to deal damage quickly. The deck focuses on cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure while also utilizing disruption spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat to control the board and protect its threats. The deck aims to win the game as fast as possible by being aggressive and proactive in its strategy.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using various spells to control the board and protect your threats. The main goal is to overwhelm your opponent with fast and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Wild Nacatl, while also having access to versatile spells like Remand and Stubborn Denial for disruption. Leyline Binding can help lock down opposing threats, while Tribal Flames provides reach to close out games. Overall, this deck aims to maintain pressure and tempo to secure victories through efficient aggression and control.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Undying Malice. Seasoned Pyromancer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional value and pressure, while Feign Death can create powerful board states. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the inclusion of Blood Moon can shut down certain strategies and give the deck an edge in certain matchups.

The main concept of this Modern Amulet Titan deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Amulet of Vigor, Azusa, and Arboreal Grazer to eventually play Primeval Titan and search for powerful lands like Valakut and Cavern of Souls. The deck aims to create explosive plays by chaining together land drops and utilizing the Titan's ability to search for key lands and put pressure on the opponent. By combining mana ramp with powerful land synergy, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents and win through a combo-centric strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and removing any threats they may have. It also utilizes a variety of spells to control the game and protect its own creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Overall, the key strategy is to be fast and efficient in dealing damage while maintaining control over the board state.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It pairs this aggression with a suite of efficient counterspells and removal spells to control the game and protect its threats. By utilizing cantrips like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and ensure consistent draws. The mana base is flexible and allows for consistent casting of spells, while also providing options for fetching specific lands when needed.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to cast spells from the graveyard and generate infinite mana through Lotus Field and Twiddle. Wishclaw Talisman and Grim Tutor are used to search for combo pieces, while controlling the board with counterspells like Pact of Negation and Spell Pierce. The goal is to set up a winning turn with Otawara, Soaring City or Grapeshot to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck is fast-paced and aims to win quickly through a powerful combo engine.

This deck aims to creatively assemble powerful creatures by using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat them onto the battlefield. It combines efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Thoughtseize with ramp cards like Explore and Dwarven Mine to control the game until it can combo off. The key strategy is to turn tokens or less-useful creatures into game-ending threats like Archon of Cruelty using Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Boseiju, Who Endures helps protect key combo pieces from countermagic, while Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and land recursion.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early disruption and aggressive creature plays to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Key cards include Thoughtseize and Grief for hand disruption, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for fast damage, and Seasoned Pyromancer for card advantage. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Terminate and Fury to deal with threats. Blood Moon can disrupt multicolor decks, while Undying Malice and Feign Death provide recursion and extra value. The deck aims to apply pressure from different angles while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of artifact creatures and use synergy between cards like Urza's Saga, Frogmite, Memnite, and Ornithopter to generate early game advantage. The deck also utilizes cards like Cranial Plating and Nettlecyst to enhance the power and toughness of its creatures, making them even more threatening. It includes a mix of artifacts and creatures to maximize the benefits of cards like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast for efficient card draw. The deck also has some disruption elements with cards like Relic of Progenitus and Shadowspear.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach and various artifacts to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur artifacts while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mishra's Bauble fuel the graveyard. The combo pieces work together to create a loop that can win the game quickly, with Teferi, Time Raveler providing disruption and protection. The deck also includes Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for additional value and Urza's Saga for further tutor options. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces and disrupting opponents to secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive and fast-paced gameplay by utilizing low-cost and high-value cards to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The strategy involves playing creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide, while also using burn spells such as Lava Spike and Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel adds additional pressure on the opponent, while cards like Boros Charm provide flexibility and Skullcrack prevents the opponent from gaining life. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with consistent and efficient damage output.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Colossus Hammer with Puresteel Paladin to equip it for free and attack for lethal damage in a single turn. The deck includes a mix of equipment tutors like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga, along with protection spells like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes to ensure the combo can go off smoothly. Additional cards like Shadowspear and Nettlecyst add versatility to the strategy, while cards like Marsh Flats and Silent Clearing provide mana fixing and card draw. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, fast combo.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cards that allow for unique and powerful combos to be created. By combining cards like Indomitable Creativity, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Persist, the deck aims to generate powerful board states and synergies that can overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Lightning Bolt to control the opponent's resources and protect its own strategy. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its approach to winning games through innovative combos and interactions.
